annotations.text:
A + B, combined.

From A: the drafting grid, the registration frame that draws itself around the headline, the dimension line, the extruded type, and the + marks at every cell corner — carried through the advisory, platform, estimator and insights sections.

From B: the computation console, now sitting on A's grid at the right of the hero, typing out the run. The product panes in the platform section keep B's title bars.

The estimator's slider is drawn as a dimension line. On the built site the hero console and the estimator are one computation: drag the slider and the console re-runs with your number — that is the 'live' you asked for, and it is what I will build next.

Right: the same direction on an inner page (Corporate Tax Engine) and on a phone.
Kept for reference only. B was merged into A; C and D were not chosen.
